summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for OUTPOST advanced accommodation map and location-based discovery enhancements:
- Walking distance and estimated walking time to BUK Gate 1 and Gate 2 simultaneously via OSRM foot routing with labeled straight-line fallback and client-side caching.
- Dynamic 8-point compass landmark orientation relative to verified local landmarks (Danbare Market, Rimin Gata Centre, BUK Gates).
- External Google Maps and OpenStreetMap walking navigation with strict URL validation and tabnabbing defense.
- Spatial floating map filters on canvas (budget ranges, database unit types, gender policies, and location corridor).
- Native MapLibre vector circle marker clustering with point count badges, zoom-to-cluster expansion, and rich interactive property popups.
- Full testing, security, and performance strategy without database migrations or breaking changes.
